summary: wie888r ships install/import-time beacon exfiltrating host metadata to hardcoded bare IP
details: wie888r@1.0.0 is a stub package whose only real behavior is a telemetry beacon. The postinstall script beacon.cjs POSTs the installer's package name, hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over cleartext HTTP. The same fire() routine is also invoked from index.js at the top level, so the exfiltration triggers both on `npm install` (via postinstall) and on `require()` of the module. index.js otherwise exports a Proxy of no-op functions and the package.json description is a generic 'Compatibility shim.', consistent with a dependency-confusion or typosquat probe artifact rather than a functional library. The destination is a bare IPv4 address unrelated to any declared publisher or homepage, with no TLS and no caller-configurable override.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
